title: AWS Unused EBS Volume Cleanup
description: Reports EBS volumes unattached beyond a minimum age and, once approved, deletes them after taking a retained recovery snapshot of each. Report-only unless Execute and a valid approval reference are both supplied.
blockedBy: job-service has no runner for type 'powershell' and no WinRM transport. This workflow is published so the agent's tool reference resolves, but every run will fail until that runner exists.

inputs.label: AWS region
inputs.help: One region per run. Volumes are region-scoped.

inputs.label: AWS profile / SSO profile
inputs.help: Leave empty to use the host's IAM role. Prefer a role over a named profile.

inputs.label: Minimum days unattached
inputs.help: Volumes detached more recently than this are never considered. The floor is 7 days deliberately — shorter catches volumes mid-migration.

inputs.label: Protection tag key
inputs.help: Any volume carrying this tag is excluded unconditionally, even with a valid approval.

inputs.label: Protected list file
inputs.help: Volume ids or names that must never be touched. Cannot be overridden by any other setting.

inputs.label: Change reason
inputs.help: Recorded in the approval artifact and the audit log.

inputs.label: ITSM ticket
inputs.help: Recorded alongside the approval reference in the audit trail.

inputs.label: Execute deletions
inputs.help: Off means report only. Switching this on deletes volumes and requires an approval reference.

inputs.label: Approval reference
inputs.help: Issued by a prior report-only run once a human approved the candidate list.

inputs.label: Skip pre-deletion snapshot
inputs.help: Strongly discouraged. The snapshot is the only recovery path.

inputs.label: Output format
inputs.help: CSV or HTML when the candidate list is going to a human approver.

nodes.label: Report unattached volumes (and delete only if approved)

requires.customerText: An AWS account this can inspect and clean up unused disks in. If you have already connected one, we will use it.
